{{Quote|Wait! Shoran has spotted an excursion of Trade Federation troops.|Qui-Gon Jinn, warning Chewbacca of an attack by Battle Droid Beta Versions|audio=ShoranHasSpotted.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The '''Battle Droid Beta Version''' was a model of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] used in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. They were assembled at [[Barracks/Legends|troop centers]] and were slower and less powerful than the standard B1 battle droid. Battle Droid Beta Versions were used in several battles in the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], where many were destroyed by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Trade Federation battle droids! They're wiping out the gundarks!|Qui-Gon Jinn during the attack on the gundark nest|audio=TU3-WNARN-L64.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The Battle Droid Beta Version was a model of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] in the [[B-series battle droid/Legends|B-series]]<ref name="GB" /> manufactured by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]]<ref name="Databank" /> They stood at 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] wielded [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]], and were much slower than the more standard B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] units.<ref name="GB" /> Battle Droid Beta Versions were assembled at [[Barracks/Legends|troop centers]].<ref name="GB" />

==Role==
{{Quote|More enemies approaching. Destroy them.|A Battle Droid Beta Version at the gundark nest|audio=MoreEnemies.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Battle Droid Beta Versions were used in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="GB" /> As battle droids they were [[Class four droid/Legends|fourth degree droids]].<ref name="Droids" />

==History==
{{Quote|Halt. You are ordered to come with us.|A Battle Droid Beta Version to Attichitcuk|audio=BattleDroidHalt.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].</ref> the Trade Federation [[Alaris Prime colonial war|sought control]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. They faced attacks from the [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]] [[Species/Legends|creatures]] in their early landings, causing the company to send a squad of eleven Battle Droid Beta Versions to [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|attack]] the [[Unidentified gundark nest|gundark nest]]. As the attack began, Wookiee [[bowcaster trooper]]s led by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who were the [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|rightful]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] of Alaris Prime, arrived at the nest with the same goal of eradicating the gundarks.<ref name="GB" /> The battle droids finished their task and immediately turned on the Wookiees, perceiving no difference between them and the gundarks,<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> but Chewbacca's Wookiees quickly dispatched the droids.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Itchy-ambush.png|thumb|right|250px|Battle Droid Beta Versions ambushed Attichitcuk.]]
The leader of the [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]], [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|encountered]] seven Battle Droid Beta Versions on a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission. The droids ordered the Wookiee to halt and shot him with their [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] when he refused, seriously wounding him. Chewbacca mounted a [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|rescue]] of Attichitcuk, first encountering three Battle Droid Beta Versions near the ford of a [[Water/Legends|river]]. They destroyed another four on the other side and a further six on their return trip to their [[Unidentified Wookiee base (Attichitcuk's rescue)|base]].<ref name="GB" />

As the Wookiees became more aggressive in their attacks on the Trade Federation, the [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] [[Army/Legends|Army]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] [[LUH-989]] sent six Battle Droid Beta Versions, along with three [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droid]], to [[Attack on Chewbacca's camp|attack]] a [[Chewbacca's camp|camp]] belonging to Chewbacca, who had become leader of the colonists. Chewbacca's ally [[Shoran]] warned [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] of the attack, who told Chewbacca to prepare his defences. The beetle droids reached the camp first but were destroyed by Chewbacca's [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], and afterwards the Battle Droid Beta Versions made it to the camp and met the same fate.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Battle Droid Beta Versions appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', as the [[Technology level|tech level 1]] trooper recruit unit for the Trade Federation. The droids cost 25 units of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] and 35 units of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] to build.<ref name="GB" />
